mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the previous 6 months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines by more than 10% over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 5% over the previous 6 months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 5% over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline by more than 100,000 over the previous 3 months, it signals a significant labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS declines > 100k in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS declines by more than 100k over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth is above 3% over the previous 6 months, it signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% and CPIAUCSL growth > 3% in 6 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is below 1% and CPIAUCSL growth is above 3% over 6 months.
